what: White bubbles float up on the canvas. In the endless type, while the panel is visible 10 bubbles (5~120px) start from the lower half and rise endlessly, re-entering from the bottom once they exit the top. In the scroll type, each downward scroll lifts 5 bubbles (5~100px, fast) from the screen bottom, then rests for 2 seconds. Size and speed scale with panel size, opacity .4, and each bubble slowly spins — aquarium/water theme

options.look: fixed: A canvas attached to the screen, not the panel (floats up over the whole screen like the original scroll type) — CSS is position: fixed
options.len: Number shown at once, default endless 10 · scroll 5
options.speed-min: Slowest speed (at 900 height), default endless 1 · scroll 5
options.cooldown: Seconds to rest before showing again in the scroll type, default 2
